summary: Join our expert-led training course on Knowledge Platforms, Portals, and Repositories. Learn to optimize information sharing and boost organizational efficiency
lede: Knowledge platform training covers designing and managing portals and repositories so people can find and use trusted information. It is for knowledge managers, platform owners, digital workplace professionals and project teams who need to connect people with useful knowledge in their daily work. Participants learn to map user needs, structure content and navigation, improve tagging and search, and establish ownership and review workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, manage, or rely on knowledge platforms, portals, and repositories.
audience: Intranet, portal, or knowledge base owners
modules: The Role of Knowledge Platforms in Modern Organizations
Information Architecture for Portals and Repositories
Integrating Knowledge Platforms into Daily Work
Knowledge Platforms in Public, NGO, and Donor-Funded Contexts
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational structures and digital tools. Experience with knowledge management or platform administration is beneficial but not required.
